pairs.question: Quis tamen ille novus perstringit lumina fulgor? Quam mitra effigiem distinxit pictor, honesto surgentem e tumulo, alatoque satellite fultam?
pairs.answer: Agnosco faciem, vultu latet alter in illo Wainfletus.
pairs.derivation: The poet poses a rhetorical double question about a bright figure in the painting ('Who is this new brightness? What figure...?') and answers it himself by identifying the face as Wainflete. Answer ends at the first full stop after 'Wainfletus'; what follows ('sic ille oculos, sic ora ferebat: Eheu quando animi par invenietur imago?') is descriptive elaboration turning into a separate unanswered lament, so it is cut. No framing/narration to strip; first-word capitalization and terminal '?' normalized.
